name: autonomous-workflows
description: Autonomous, evidence-driven workflows. /factory turns an approved spec into an MVP unattended, ten agents at once in isolated worktrees with an adversary pass on every diff; /remediate self-drives a test-verified fix loop that can't cheat its way to green; /harden-repos fans out one fresh-context agent per repo; /mine-provenance audits your portfolio against ground-truth git/code/test artifacts.
